note: Failing forward (vision plan 4.3): a failed, abandoned or expired job changes the world where it happened for a while. Families come from the objective type. {requester}, {system}, {place} and {faction} are filled in code.

radio: The delivery {requester} was waiting on never came. Supply desks in {system} are rationing, and prices are up.
Word in {system}: a shipment went missing on the way to {place}. Traders have already put their prices up.
Nobody stopped the {faction} crews around {system}. They're getting bolder. Fly in pairs.
The contract on the {faction} raiders in {system} went unfinished. Their patrols are pushing closer to the lanes.
Whatever {requester} was trying to find out in {system}, the trail has gone cold. Someone out there is relieved.
The questions {requester} was asking in {system} went unanswered. The answers are getting harder to find.
